interpretation.temporal_pattern: Failure frequency rises sharply as the requested timestep becomes smaller under the same absolute 1e-12 compartment-balance criterion.
interpretation.note: The census establishes classification, not cause. The dominant local-compartment residual floor must be investigated separately from the minority aggregate-total-only class.

preregistered_stage_b_c_scope_note: Stages B and C remain restricted to the five cases frozen before this census. Because those cases emphasize the previously observed TOTAL_ONLY archetypes and controls, they do not constitute an adjudication of the newly established dominant LOCAL_BAL class. No post-census case substitution or addition is permitted inside P2E04.
next_permitted_action: Execute P2E04 Stages B and C exactly as preregistered on the original five target cases. If the dominant LOCAL_BAL class remains scientifically relevant afterward, open a separate preregistered workunit for that class rather than modifying P2E04 post hoc.
